title: Concept: LDAP filter built by concatenation (java) — review required
description: In java, .searchs*([^)]*+ mixes filter syntax with values. LDAP metacharacters (*, (, ), \) in input alter which entries match. The remedy is value escaping via Filter escaping per RFC 4515.
applicability: java codebases querying directories with assembled filters; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Authentication bypass and directory disclosure; HIGH severity for login paths.
